subject.title: Route org publisher abuse nominations to org review

question: Should org publisher abuse nominations bypass user-ban enforcement and move to the new org/member review lane implemented by this draft PR?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes moderation policy for how abusive org publishers are escalated, so automation should not choose the policy on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Continue maintainer review
options.body: Keep this PR open, confirm the org-review policy and proof expectations, then undraft or merge through the normal maintainer flow.

options.title: Require visible UI proof first
options.body: Ask for a real ClawHub management UI screenshot or browser proof of the org-review lane before undrafting.

options.title: Rework the policy
options.body: Pause this branch if org publisher nominations should remain in a generic policy queue or need an explicit org-suspension action before leaving pending enforcement.

recommendation.title: Continue maintainer review
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, confirm the org-review policy and proof expectations, then undraft or merge through the normal maintainer flow.

likelyOwner.reason: jesse-merhi owns the current draft and has recent current-main history in the publisher-abuse moderation path.
